evals.prompt: translate this PDF contract to Chinese while preserving original layout and tables
evals.expected_output: A five-step execution flow: physical coordinate inspection, two-stage zero-hallucination translation, CSS @page vector layout reconstruction, Playwright rendering, and automated audit.
expectations: The agent probes page bounding boxes, figure dimensions, and baseline anchors before drafting CSS
The translation preserves all clauses, numerical thresholds, units, and table structures without arbitrary omission or summary
The HTML uses CSS @page paged media and overflow protection to prevent unwanted blank pages
The output PDF is verified using scripts/audit_pdf.py against the source document before delivery

evals.prompt: translate this 15-page technical specification PDF with diagrams
evals.expected_output: A chunked processing plan splitting the document into modular batches (<= 10 pages per batch) to prevent LLM attention degradation.
expectations: The agent detects total page count > 10 and adopts a modular chunking strategy
Image rects and dimensions are measured directly via PyMuPDF get_image_rects rather than arbitrary fixed clamp heights
Each batch is rendered and audited symmetrically against the original document

evals.prompt: audit this translated PDF against original.pdf
evals.expected_output: An automated audit report generated by scripts/audit_pdf.py comparing page count, vector layers, and clause integrity.
expectations: The agent invokes scripts/audit_pdf.py with --src and --tgt parameters
The audit checks 1:1 page count alignment, vector graphics layers, and anti-hallucination radar keywords
Side-by-side comparison images are provided for visual review
